spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m2p6t5 ----
EXTENDS FiniteSets
CONSTANT Towers
VARIABLES phase, vote, taken, override
vars == <<phase, vote, taken, override>>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ vote = [t \in Towers |-> "none"]
    /\ taken = {}
    /\ override = FALSE

CastYes(t) == phase = "collecting" /\ vote[t] = "none"
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![t] = "yes"] /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, taken, override>>
CastNo(t) == phase = "collecting" /\ vote[t] = "none"
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![t] = "no"] /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, taken, override>>

Commit == phase = "collecting" /\ \A t \in Towers : vote[t] = "yes"
    /\ phase' = "committed" /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, taken, override>>
Abort == phase = "collecting" /\ \E t \in Towers : vote[t] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted" /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, taken, override>>

EngageOverride == override = FALSE /\ override' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, taken>>

Take(t) == (phase = "committed" \/ override) /\ t \notin taken
    /\ taken' = taken \cup {t} /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, override>>

Reset == phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "collecting" /\ vote' = [t \in Towers |-> "none"]
    /\ taken' = {} /\ override' = FALSE

Next == (\E t \in Towers : CastYes(t) \/ CastNo(t) \/ Take(t))
    \/ Commit \/ Abort \/ EngageOverride \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RunwayOnlyWhenAuthorized ==
    (taken = {}) \/ (phase = "committed") \/ override
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Towers = {t1, t2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RunwayOnlyWhenAuthorized
nl:
An air-traffic control center allocates the single active runway to one of two regional towers using a two-phase commit. A coordinator first collects a vote from each tower on whether it is ready to accept the runway; each tower votes yes or no exactly once. If both towers vote yes the coordinator moves the transaction to the committed phase; if any tower votes no the transaction is aborted. Only once the transaction is committed is a tower permitted to actually take the runway (perform its irreversible landing-clearance action). A supervising controller holds an admin override that, when engaged, also authorizes a tower to take the runway even outside a normal commit, for emergency landings. The model tracks the coordinator phase, each tower's vote, the set of towers that have taken the runway, and whether the admin override is engaged.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no tower ever takes the runway unless the two-phase commit has reached the committed phase or the admin override is engaged.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m5p5t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Cranes, Quorum
VARIABLES voted, fireCount
vars == <<voted, fireCount>>

Init == voted = {} /\ fireCount = 0

Vote(c) == c \notin voted /\ voted' = voted \cup {c} /\ UNCHANGED fireCount
Fire == Cardinality(voted) >= Quorum /\ fireCount = 0
    /\ fireCount' = fireCount + 1 /\ UNCHANGED voted
Reset == fireCount = 1 /\ voted' = {} /\ fireCount' = 0

Next == (\E c \in Cranes : Vote(c)) \/ Fire \/ Reset
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ClampReleaseAtMostOnce == fireCount <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Cranes = {c1, c2, c3}
CONSTANT Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ClampReleaseAtMostOnce
nl:
A container-ship crane yard authorizes a single irreversible ship-departure clamp release through quorum voting among its cranes. Each crane may cast one vote approving the release; because votes travel over an unreliable yard network they may arrive in any order, so the coordinator simply accumulates the set of cranes that have voted. Once at least a quorum of cranes have voted, the clamp release may fire, an irreversible physical action. The model tracks the set of cranes that have voted and a counter of how many times the clamp release has fired. After a departure completes the yard is reset for the next ship, clearing the votes and the fire counter.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the irreversible clamp release fires at most once per ship cycle.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m3p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, MaxTerm
VARIABLES leader, term, calib
vars == <<leader, term, calib>>

Init == leader = "none" /\ term = 0 /\ calib = 0

Elect(r) == term < MaxTerm /\ term' = term + 1 /\ leader' = r /\ UNCHANGED calib
Crash == leader # "none" /\ leader' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED <<term, calib>>
Calibrate == leader # "none" /\ calib = 0 /\ calib' = 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>
Reset == term = MaxTerm /\ leader = "none" /\ term' = 0 /\ calib' = 0 /\ UNCHANGED leader

Next == (\E r \in Robots : Elect(r)) \/ Crash \/ Calibrate \/ Reset
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CalibrateAtMostOnce == calib <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Robots = {r1, r2}
CONSTANT MaxTerm = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CalibrateAtMostOnce
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet elects a leader that is solely responsible for performing a one-time irreversible dock-calibration action. Leadership is tracked by a monotonically increasing term number; any robot may win a fresh election by taking the next term, and the previous leader may fail over (crash) leaving the post vacant until a new election. A robot may be slow but not failed, so elections can occur at any time up to a bounded number of terms. Only the current leader may perform the dock-calibration, and it may only ever be performed once across the entire run regardless of how many leadership changes occur. The model tracks the current leader, the current term, and how many times the calibration has been performed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the irreversible dock-calibration action is performed at most once across all leadership terms.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m4p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Total, Cap
VARIABLES available, reserved, dispensed
vars == <<available, reserved, dispensed>>

Init == available = Total /\ reserved = 0 /\ dispensed = 0

Reserve == available > 0 /\ reserved < Cap
    /\ available' = available - 1 /\ reserved' = reserved + 1 /\ UNCHANGED dispensed
Dispense == reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1 /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1 /\ UNCHANGED available
Return == reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1 /\ available' = available + 1 /\ UNCHANGED dispensed
Recycle == dispensed > 0
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed - 1 /\ available' = available + 1 /\ UNCHANGED reserved

Next == Reserve \/ Dispense \/ Return \/ Recycle
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

UnitsConserved == available + reserved + dispensed = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Total = 3
CONSTANT Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT UnitsConserved
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker moves a fixed total number of blood units through three states: available on the shelf, reserved for an operation, and dispensed to a patient. Reservation requests are served through a bounded work queue: a unit may be reserved only while the number of currently reserved units stays under a capacity limit, providing backpressure. A reserved unit may then be dispensed, or returned to the shelf if the requesting operation is cancelled. A worker handling dispensed units may crash silently, in which case a dispensed unit is recycled back onto the shelf. No matter what happens, blood units are neither created nor destroyed; the three counts always sum to the same fixed total.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of blood units is conserved, with available plus reserved plus dispensed always equal to the fixed total.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m5p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Cars, Floors, Quorum
VARIABLES assign, votes, override
vars == <<assign, votes, override>>

Init == assign = [c \in Cars |-> "none"] /\ votes = 0 /\ override = FALSE

Vote == votes < Cardinality(Cars) /\ votes' = votes + 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, override>>
EngageOverride == override = FALSE /\ override' = TRUE /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, votes>>
Allocate(c, f) == assign[c] = "none" /\ (votes >= Quorum \/ override)
    /\ (\A o \in Cars : assign[o] # f)
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![c] = f] /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, override>>
Release(c) == assign[c] # "none"
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![c] = "none"] /\ votes' = 0 /\ UNCHANGED override

Next == Vote \/ EngageOverride \/ (\E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : Allocate(c, f))
    \/ (\E c \in Cars : Release(c))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A a, b \in Cars : (a # b /\ assign[a] # "none") => assign[a] # assign[b]
====
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper assigns each elevator car to serve a destination floor. A dispatch request is authorized either by a quorum of the building's floor sensors voting, or by a building admin engaging a manual override. When authorized, a free car may be assigned to a floor only if no other car is already assigned to that same floor, preventing two cars from being dispatched to the identical slot. A car that has finished serving its floor is released and becomes free again, which also clears the accumulated sensor votes for the next dispatch. The model tracks each car's assigned floor, the number of sensor votes accumulated, and whether the admin override is engaged.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no two distinct elevator cars are ever assigned to serve the same destination floor at the same time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m0p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Drones, MaxVer
VARIABLES count, version, snap
vars == <<count, version, snap>>

Init == count = 0 /\ version = 0 /\ snap = [d \in Drones |-> -1]

Read(d) == snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = version] /\ UNCHANGED <<count, version>>
Commit(d) == snap[d] = version /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ count' = snap[d] + 1 /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = -1]
Abort(d) == snap[d] # -1 /\ snap[d] # version
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = -1] /\ UNCHANGED <<count, version>>

Next == \E d \in Drones : Read(d) \/ Commit(d) \/ Abort(d)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdates == count = version
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Drones = {d1, d2}
CONSTANT MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdates
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm maintains one shared situation record holding a count of confirmed fire fronts, plus a version number that increments on every successful update. Because telemetry messages arrive out of order, a drone first reads a snapshot of the current version, then later tries to commit an increment. The commit succeeds only if the version it read still matches the live version (optimistic locking); if another drone committed in between, the snapshot is stale and the drone must abort and re-read before retrying. Each successful commit raises both the recorded count and the version by one. Because every applied update is anchored to the version it observed, no update is ever silently overwritten or lost. The model tracks the shared count, the shared version, and each drone's read snapshot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no update is lost, so the recorded fire-front count always equals the shared version number.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m4p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Pharmacists, QueueCap
VARIABLES holders, waiting
vars == <<holders, waiting>>

Init == holders = {} /\ waiting = {}

Request(p) == p \notin holders /\ p \notin waiting /\ Cardinality(waiting) < QueueCap
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {p} /\ UNCHANGED holders
Acquire(p) == holders = {} /\ p \in waiting
    /\ holders' = {p} /\ waiting' = waiting \ {p}
Release(p) == p \in holders /\ holders' = holders \ {p} /\ UNCHANGED waiting

Next == \E p \in Pharmacists : Request(p) \/ Acquire(p) \/ Release(p)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusiveDispenser == Cardinality(holders) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Pharmacists = {p1, p2, p3}
CONSTANT QueueCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusiveDispenser
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser is a single automated cabinet that only one pharmacist may operate at a time. Pharmacists that want access join a bounded waiting queue; the queue applies backpressure, refusing new entrants once it is full. A waiting pharmacist may acquire the cabinet only when no one currently holds it, after which they are removed from the queue and become the sole holder. A pharmacist may be slow but not failed, so a holder eventually releases the cabinet, making it free for the next waiter. The model tracks the set of pharmacists currently holding the cabinet and the set of pharmacists waiting in the queue.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one pharmacist holds the dispensing cabinet at any time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m0p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Lobbies, MaxCap
VARIABLES inCrit, lock, cap
vars == <<inCrit, lock, cap>>

Init == inCrit = [l \in Lobbies |-> FALSE] /\ lock = "free" /\ cap = 1

Enter(l) == lock = "free" /\ ~inCrit[l]
    /\ inCrit' = [inCrit EXCEPT ![l] = TRUE] /\ lock' = l /\ UNCHANGED cap
Exit(l) == lock = l /\ inCrit[l]
    /\ inCrit' = [inCrit EXCEPT ![l] = FALSE] /\ lock' = "free" /\ UNCHANGED cap
Grow == cap < MaxCap /\ cap' = cap + 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<inCrit, lock>>
Shrink == cap > 1 /\ cap' = cap - 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<inCrit, lock>>

Next == (\E l \in Lobbies : Enter(l) \/ Exit(l)) \/ Grow \/ Shrink
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OneLobbyInCritical == Cardinality({l \in Lobbies : inCrit[l]}) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Lobbies = {l1, l2}
CONSTANT MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneLobbyInCritical
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker guards a single ranked-match server that only one lobby may occupy at a time. Access is arbitrated by an optimistic lock: the shared lock is either free or names the owning lobby. A lobby enters the critical ranked server only when the lock reads free, at which point it stamps the lock with its own identity and marks itself as in the critical section; when done it clears its flag and returns the lock to free, retrying later if it lost a race. Separately, the matchmaker's seat capacity can change at runtime, growing or shrinking within fixed bounds as servers are added or removed. The model tracks which lobbies are in the critical section, the lock holder, and the current capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one lobby is inside the ranked-match critical section at any time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m6p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, Dur, MaxNow
VARIABLES owner, expiry, now, routing
vars == <<owner, expiry, now, routing>>

Init == owner = "none" /\ expiry = 0 /\ now = 0 /\ routing = "none"

Tick == now < MaxNow /\ now' = now + 1
    /\ routing' = (IF now + 1 >= expiry THEN "none" ELSE routing)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry>>
Acquire(c) == (owner = "none" \/ now >= expiry) /\ routing = "none"
    /\ owner' = c /\ expiry' = now + Dur /\ UNCHANGED <<now, routing>>
Route(c) == owner = c /\ now < expiry /\ routing' = c /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, now>>
StopRoute == routing # "none" /\ routing' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, now>>

Next == Tick \/ StopRoute \/ (\E c \in Controllers : Acquire(c) \/ Route(c))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RouteOnlyWithValidLease ==
    routing = "none" \/ (owner = routing /\ now < expiry)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Controllers = {ca, cb}
CONSTANT Dur = 2
CONSTANT MaxNow = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RouteOnlyWithValidLease
nl:
An airport baggage router uses two interchangeable routing controllers that share one conveyor pool, coordinated by a time-limited lease. A discrete clock advances in ticks. A controller acquires the lease only when the pool is unowned or the previous lease has expired, stamping an expiry a fixed duration in the future. Only the controller that currently holds a valid, unexpired lease may actively route bags; a controller whose lease has expired is stale and must not route. The model tracks the lease owner, the lease expiry time, the current clock, and which controller, if any, is presently routing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a controller routes bags only while it is the lease owner and its lease has not yet expired.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m4p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
CONSTANTS MaxCap
VARIABLES queue, cap, dumps
vars == <<queue, cap, dumps>>

Init == queue = <<>> /\ cap = 1 /\ dumps = 0

Enqueue == Len(queue) < cap /\ queue' = Append(queue, "task") /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, dumps>>
Dequeue == Len(queue) > 0 /\ queue' = Tail(queue) /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, dumps>>
Grow == cap < MaxCap /\ cap' = cap + 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, dumps>>
Shrink == cap > 1 /\ cap' = cap - 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, dumps>>
Dump == Len(queue) = 0 /\ dumps = 0 /\ dumps' = 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, cap>>
ResetMission == dumps = 1 /\ dumps' = 0 /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, cap>>

Next == Enqueue \/ Dequeue \/ Grow \/ Shrink \/ Dump \/ ResetMission
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DumpAtMostOnce == dumps <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DumpAtMostOnce
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm buffers survey tasks in a bounded work queue whose capacity changes at runtime as drones enter or leave service. New tasks may be enqueued only while the queue length is below the current capacity, applying backpressure; queued tasks are dequeued as they are surveyed. When the queue has been fully drained the swarm may execute a single irreversible return-to-base retardant dump, which must happen at most once per mission before the mission is reset. The model tracks the task queue as a sequence, the current capacity, and a counter of how many times the irreversible dump has fired.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the irreversible retardant dump fires at most once per mission.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m4p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Seats, QueueCap
VARIABLES seated, waiting
vars == <<seated, waiting>>

Init == seated = 0 /\ waiting = 0

Join == waiting < QueueCap /\ waiting' = waiting + 1 /\ UNCHANGED seated
Admit == waiting > 0 /\ seated < Seats
    /\ seated' = seated + 1 /\ waiting' = waiting - 1
Leave == seated > 0 /\ seated' = seated - 1 /\ UNCHANGED waiting

Next == Join \/ Admit \/ Leave
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SeatsNotExceeded == seated <= Seats
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Seats = 2
CONSTANT QueueCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SeatsNotExceeded
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker admits players into a match that has a fixed seat capacity. Players first join a bounded waiting queue, which refuses new arrivals once it is full, providing backpressure. A waiting player is admitted into the match only while the number of seated players is still below the seat capacity; once seated, a player may later leave, freeing a seat. A slow player may linger, but the matchmaker never seats more players than the capacity allows. The model tracks the number of seated players and the number of players waiting in the queue.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of seated players never exceeds the fixed seat capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m0p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Cars, MaxVer
VARIABLES inShaft, version, snap
vars == <<inShaft, version, snap>>

Init == inShaft = {} /\ version = 0 /\ snap = [c \in Cars |-> -1]

Read(c) == snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = version] /\ UNCHANGED <<inShaft, version>>
Enter(c) == snap[c] = version /\ inShaft = {} /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ inShaft' = {c} /\ version' = version + 1 /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = -1]
Exit(c) == c \in inShaft /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ inShaft' = {} /\ version' = version + 1 /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next == \E c \in Cars : Read(c) \/ Enter(c) \/ Exit(c)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OneCarInShaft == Cardinality(inShaft) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Cars = {c1, c2}
CONSTANT MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneCarInShaft
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper protects a shared maintenance shaft that at most one car may occupy. Access is coordinated by an optimistic version lock. Because control messages arrive out of order, a car first reads a snapshot of the current lock version, then later attempts to enter. Entry succeeds only if the snapshot still matches the live version and the shaft is empty; on success the car occupies the shaft and the version is bumped, invalidating other cars' stale snapshots so they must re-read and retry. When a car exits, it bumps the version again. The model tracks the set of cars in the shaft, the shared version, and each car's read snapshot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one elevator car occupies the maintenance shaft at any time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m3p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Printers, MaxVer, MaxCap
VARIABLES leader, record, version, cap
vars == <<leader, record, version, cap>>

Init == leader = "none" /\ record = 0 /\ version = 0 /\ cap = 1

Elect(p) == leader' = p /\ UNCHANGED <<record, version, cap>>
Failover == leader # "none" /\ leader' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED <<record, version, cap>>
Commit == leader # "none" /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ record' = record + 1 /\ version' = version + 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, cap>>
Grow == cap < MaxCap /\ cap' = cap + 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, record, version>>
Shrink == cap > 1 /\ cap' = cap - 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, record, version>>

Next == (\E p \in Printers : Elect(p)) \/ Failover \/ Commit \/ Grow \/ Shrink
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoJobLost == record = version
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Printers = {pa, pb}
CONSTANT MaxVer = 3
CONSTANT MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoJobLost
nl:
A print shop job spooler keeps a shared record of completed print jobs together with a version number that advances in lock-step with the record. At any moment one printer is elected leader and is the only one allowed to commit a completed job to the shared record; each commit raises both the completed-job count and the version by one, so they never drift apart. The current leader may fail over, leaving the post vacant until another printer is elected. The spool's buffer capacity changes at runtime within fixed bounds. Because only the sequential leader ever writes and each write advances the record and version together, no completed job is ever lost or overwritten. The model tracks the current leader, the completed-job record, the version, and the current spool capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no completed job is lost, so the completed-job record always equals the version number.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m1p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Cap
VARIABLES token, inUse, override
vars == <<token, inUse, override>>

Init == token = 0 /\ inUse = 0 /\ override = FALSE

PassToken == token' = (token + 1) % Nodes /\ UNCHANGED <<inUse, override>>
EngageOverride == override = FALSE /\ override' = TRUE /\ UNCHANGED <<token, inUse>>
Book(n) == (token = n \/ override) /\ inUse < Cap
    /\ inUse' = inUse + 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<token, override>>
Complete == inUse > 0 /\ inUse' = inUse - 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<token, override>>

Next == PassToken \/ EngageOverride \/ Complete \/ (\E n \in 0 .. (Nodes - 1) : Book(n))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RoomsWithinCapacity == inUse <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Nodes = 2
CONSTANT Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RoomsWithinCapacity
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler grants the right to book an operating room via a token that circulates around a ring of departmental schedulers; the token advances one position at a time. A scheduler may book a room only when it currently holds the token, or when the hospital admin has engaged a global override that lets any scheduler book. Bookings consume rooms from a fixed pool and may only proceed while the number of rooms in use is below the pool capacity; a completed operation frees its room. The model tracks the token position, the number of rooms currently in use, and whether the admin override is engaged.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of operating rooms in use never exceeds the fixed room-pool capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m5p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Sensors, Quorum, Cap
VARIABLES dispatched, votes
vars == <<dispatched, votes>>

Init == dispatched = 0 /\ votes = {}

Vote(s) == s \notin votes /\ votes' = votes \cup {s} /\ UNCHANGED dispatched
Dispatch == Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum /\ dispatched < Cap
    /\ dispatched' = dispatched + 1 /\ votes' = {}
Arrive == dispatched > 0 /\ dispatched' = dispatched - 1 /\ UNCHANGED votes

Next == (\E s \in Sensors : Vote(s)) \/ Dispatch \/ Arrive
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DispatchWithinCapacity == dispatched <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Sensors = {s1, s2, s3}
CONSTANT Quorum = 2
CONSTANT Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DispatchWithinCapacity
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper dispatches cars from a fixed-size pool, never running more cars simultaneously than the bank's capacity. Each dispatch must be authorized by a quorum of floor-call sensors. Because sensor messages arrive out of order, the controller accumulates the set of sensors that have voted for the pending dispatch. Once a quorum has voted and a car is still available under the capacity limit, one car is dispatched and the accumulated votes are cleared for the next round. A dispatched car eventually arrives and returns to the pool. The model tracks the number of cars currently dispatched and the set of sensors that have voted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of simultaneously dispatched cars never exceeds the bank's capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m6p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Printers, Dur, MaxNow
VARIABLES active, owner, expiry, now
vars == <<active, owner, expiry, now>>

Init == active = {} /\ owner = "none" /\ expiry = 0 /\ now = 0

Tick == now < MaxNow /\ now' = now + 1
    /\ active' = (IF now + 1 >= expiry THEN {} ELSE active) /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry>>
Acquire(p) == (owner = "none" \/ now >= expiry)
    /\ owner' = p /\ expiry' = now + Dur /\ UNCHANGED <<active, now>>
Start(p) == owner = p /\ now < expiry /\ active = {}
    /\ active' = {p} /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, now>>
Finish(p) == p \in active /\ active' = active \ {p} /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, now>>
Crash(p) == owner = p
    /\ owner' = "none" /\ active' = active \ {p} /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, now>>

Next == Tick \/ (\E p \in Printers : Acquire(p) \/ Start(p) \/ Finish(p) \/ Crash(p))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnePrinterActive == Cardinality(active) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Printers = {pa, pb}
CONSTANT Dur = 2
CONSTANT MaxNow = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnePrinterActive
nl:
A print shop job spooler shares one physical press among several printers using a time-limited lease. A discrete clock advances in ticks; a lease expires once the clock reaches its expiry, and when that happens any active printing on the press is preempted. A printer acquires the lease only when the press is unowned or the current lease has expired. Only the printer holding a valid lease may start printing, and it may start only when the press is not already in use. A printer may crash silently, immediately dropping its lease and vacating the press. The model tracks the set of printers actively using the press, the lease owner, the lease expiry time, and the clock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one printer is actively using the press at any time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m7p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Cranes, MaxEpoch, MaxCap
VARIABLES reg, grabbed, actor, cap
vars == <<reg, grabbed, actor, cap>>

Init == reg = 0 /\ grabbed = [c \in Cranes |-> -1] /\ actor = "none" /\ cap = 1

Grab(c) == grabbed' = [grabbed EXCEPT ![c] = reg] /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, actor, cap>>
Bump == reg < MaxEpoch /\ reg' = reg + 1 /\ actor' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED <<grabbed, cap>>
Act(c) == grabbed[c] = reg /\ actor' = c /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, grabbed, cap>>
Clear == actor # "none" /\ actor' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, grabbed, cap>>
Grow == cap < MaxCap /\ cap' = cap + 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, grabbed, actor>>
Shrink == cap > 1 /\ cap' = cap - 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, grabbed, actor>>

Next == Bump \/ Clear \/ Grow \/ Shrink \/ (\E c \in Cranes : Grab(c) \/ Act(c))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleCraneActs == actor = "none" \/ grabbed[actor] = reg
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Cranes = {k1, k2}
CONSTANT MaxEpoch = 2
CONSTANT MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleCraneActs
nl:
A container-ship crane yard authorizes crane actions through a shared compare-and-swap epoch register. Each crane may grab the current epoch value from the register. A reconfiguration bumps the register's epoch by one and simultaneously cancels any currently acting crane, so cranes holding an old epoch become stale. A crane may perform a yard action only if the epoch it grabbed still compares-equal to the live register epoch; a stale crane must re-grab first. The yard's working capacity changes at runtime within fixed bounds. The model tracks the register epoch, the epoch each crane grabbed, which crane is currently acting, and the current capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no crane acts while stale, so the acting crane always holds an epoch equal to the live register epoch.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m5p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Scanners, Quorum, Cap
VARIABLES belt, votes
vars == <<belt, votes>>

Init == belt = <<>> /\ votes = {}

Vote(s) == s \notin votes /\ votes' = votes \cup {s} /\ UNCHANGED belt
Admit == Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum /\ Len(belt) < Cap
    /\ belt' = Append(belt, "bag") /\ votes' = {}
Deliver == Len(belt) > 0 /\ belt' = Tail(belt) /\ UNCHANGED votes

Next == (\E s \in Scanners : Vote(s)) \/ Admit \/ Deliver
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BeltWithinCapacity == Len(belt) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Scanners = {s1, s2}
CONSTANT Quorum = 2
CONSTANT Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BeltWithinCapacity
nl:
An airport baggage router loads bags onto a conveyor belt that holds at most a fixed number of bags. Admitting each bag requires authorization by a quorum of scanner stations. Because scanner messages arrive out of order, the router accumulates the set of scanners that have voted for the pending bag. Once a quorum has voted and the belt still has room under its capacity, the bag is appended to the belt and the votes are cleared for the next bag. Bags at the head of the belt are eventually delivered and removed. The model tracks the belt as a sequence of bags and the set of scanners that have voted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of bags on the belt never exceeds the belt's capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m4p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Workers, QueueCap
VARIABLES authorized, queue, actor
vars == <<authorized, queue, actor>>

Init == authorized = {} /\ queue = 0 /\ actor = "none"

Grant(w) == w \notin authorized /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {w} /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, actor>>
Enqueue == queue < QueueCap /\ queue' = queue + 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, actor>>
Process(w) == w \in authorized /\ queue > 0
    /\ actor' = w /\ queue' = queue - 1 /\ UNCHANGED authorized
Clear == actor # "none" /\ actor' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, queue>>
Crash(w) == w \in authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {w}
    /\ actor' = (IF actor = w THEN "none" ELSE actor) /\ UNCHANGED queue

Next == Enqueue \/ Clear \/ (\E w \in Workers : Grant(w) \/ Process(w) \/ Crash(w))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyAuthorizedProcesses == actor = "none" \/ actor \in authorized
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Workers = {w1, w2}
CONSTANT QueueCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyAuthorizedProcesses
nl:
An airport baggage router dispatches routing tasks from a bounded work queue that refuses new tasks once full, applying backpressure. Routing workers must hold a current authorization session to act; the set of authorized workers is maintained explicitly. A worker may process a queued task only while it is in the authorized set. A worker may crash silently, which immediately revokes its authorization and stops it if it was the one acting. The model tracks the set of currently authorized workers, the number of tasks in the queue, and which worker, if any, is presently processing a task.
SAFETY PROPERTY: only a currently authorized worker is ever the one processing a task.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m8p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Lines
VARIABLES coarse, fine, seals
vars == <<coarse, fine, seals>>

Init == coarse = "none" /\ fine = "none" /\ seals = 0

AcquireCoarse(l) == coarse = "none" /\ coarse' = l /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, seals>>
AcquireFine(l) == coarse = l /\ fine = "none" /\ fine' = l /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, seals>>
Seal(l) == fine = l /\ seals = 0 /\ seals' = 1 /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>
ReleaseFine(l) == fine = l /\ fine' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, seals>>
ReleaseCoarse(l) == coarse = l /\ fine = "none" /\ coarse' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, seals>>
ResetCar == seals = 1 /\ seals' = 0 /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Next == ResetCar \/ (\E l \in Lines :
    AcquireCoarse(l) \/ AcquireFine(l) \/ Seal(l) \/ ReleaseFine(l) \/ ReleaseCoarse(l))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SealAtMostOnce == seals <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Lines = {l1, l2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SealAtMostOnce
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line shares one wax-seal stall between two independent wash lines drawing from a common pool. Access is governed by hierarchical locking: a line must first take the coarse bay lock, and only while holding the coarse lock may it take the fine lock on the wax stall. Only a line holding the fine lock may apply the wax seal, an irreversible action that may occur at most once per car. Locks are released in the reverse order: the fine lock first, then the coarse lock. Once a car is sealed the line resets for the next car. The model tracks the holder of the coarse lock, the holder of the fine lock, and a counter of how many times the seal has been applied.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the irreversible wax seal is applied at most once per car.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m7p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Heads, Total
VARIABLES stock, dispensed, snap
vars == <<stock, dispensed, snap>>

Init == stock = Total /\ dispensed = 0 /\ snap = [h \in Heads |-> -1]

Read(h) == snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![h] = stock] /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, dispensed>>
Dispense(h) == snap[h] = stock /\ stock > 0
    /\ stock' = stock - 1 /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1 /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![h] = -1]
Abort(h) == snap[h] # -1 /\ snap[h] # stock
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![h] = -1] /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, dispensed>>
Return == dispensed > 0
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed - 1 /\ stock' = stock + 1 /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next == Return \/ (\E h \in Heads : Read(h) \/ Dispense(h) \/ Abort(h))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PillsConserved == stock + dispensed = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Heads = {h1, h2}
CONSTANT Total = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PillsConserved
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser shares one pill stock between two dispensing heads that coordinate through a compare-and-swap register holding the current stock level. A head first reads a snapshot of the stock, then attempts to dispense one pill: the compare-and-swap succeeds only if the snapshot still equals the live stock and stock remains, decrementing stock and incrementing the dispensed tally atomically. If another head changed the stock in between, the snapshot is stale and the head aborts and re-reads. A dispensed pill may also be returned to stock. Pills are never created or destroyed. The model tracks the current stock, the dispensed tally, and each head's read snapshot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: pills are conserved, so the current stock plus the dispensed tally always equals the fixed total.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m8p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Controllers
VARIABLES region, onRunway
vars == <<region, onRunway>>

Init == region = "none" /\ onRunway = {}

AcquireRegion(c) == region = "none" /\ region' = c /\ UNCHANGED onRunway
EnterRunway(c) == region = c /\ onRunway = {} /\ onRunway' = {c} /\ UNCHANGED region
ExitRunway(c) == c \in onRunway /\ onRunway' = onRunway \ {c} /\ UNCHANGED region
ReleaseRegion(c) == region = c /\ onRunway = {} /\ region' = "none" /\ UNCHANGED onRunway

Next == \E c \in Controllers :
    AcquireRegion(c) \/ EnterRunway(c) \/ ExitRunway(c) \/ ReleaseRegion(c)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OneFlightOnRunway == Cardinality(onRunway) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Controllers = {c1, c2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneFlightOnRunway
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator lets two control instances, sharing one airfield pool, coordinate exclusive use of a single active runway through hierarchical locks. A controller must first take the coarse airspace-region lock; only while holding the region lock may it take the fine runway lock and move a flight onto the runway. The runway may hold at most one flight at a time. Locks are released in reverse order: the runway is vacated first, then the region lock is released. The model tracks which controller holds the region lock and the set of controllers currently occupying the runway.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one controller occupies the active runway at any time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m7p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Dispatchers, Cap
VARIABLES active, snap
vars == <<active, snap>>

Init == active = 0 /\ snap = [d \in Dispatchers |-> -1]

Read(d) == snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = active] /\ UNCHANGED active
Admit(d) == snap[d] = active /\ active < Cap
    /\ active' = active + 1 /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = -1]
Abort(d) == snap[d] # -1 /\ snap[d] # active
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = -1] /\ UNCHANGED active
Leave == active > 0 /\ active' = active - 1 /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next == Leave \/ (\E d \in Dispatchers : Read(d) \/ Admit(d) \/ Abort(d))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ActiveWithinCapacity == active <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANT Dispatchers = {g1, g2}
CONSTANT Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ActiveWithinCapacity
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet limits how many robots may be simultaneously active in a shared charging zone, coordinated by two dispatchers that share the pool through a compare-and-swap register holding the active count. A dispatcher reads a snapshot of the active count, then attempts to admit one robot: the compare-and-swap succeeds only if the snapshot still equals the live count and the count is below the zone capacity, atomically incrementing the count. If another dispatcher changed the count in between, the snapshot is stale and the dispatcher aborts and re-reads. An active robot may leave, decrementing the count. The model tracks the active count and each dispatcher's read snapshot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of active robots in the zone never exceeds the zone capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m3p3t0 ----
CONSTANTS Units, Feeders
VARIABLES leader, holds
vars == <<leader, holds>>

Init == leader = "none" /\ holds = [u \in Units |-> "none"]

Elect(u) == leader' = u /\ UNCHANGED holds
Crash(u) == leader = u
    /\ leader' = "none" /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![u] = "none"]
Assign(u, f) == leader # "none" /\ holds[u] = "none" /\ (\A o \in Units : holds[o] # f)
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![u] = f] /\ UNCHANGED leader
Release(u) == holds[u] # "none" /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![u] = "none"] /\ UNCHANGED leader

Next == (\E u \in Units : Elect(u) \/ Crash(u) \/ Release(u))
    \/ (\E u \in Units, f \in Feeders : Assign(u, f))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoSharedFeeder ==
    \A a, b \in Units : (a # b /\ holds[a] # "none") => holds[a] # holds[b]
====
nl:
A power-grid load shedder assigns each shedding unit to a distinct feeder slot so that load is dropped in a coordinated way. At any time one unit is the elected leader and is the only one permitted to make assignments; a unit may assign itself to a free feeder only if no other unit currently holds that feeder. The leader may crash silently, which vacates the leadership and releases whatever feeder the crashed unit held. A unit may also voluntarily release its feeder. Leadership can fail over to another unit through a fresh election. The model tracks the current leader and, for each unit, which feeder slot it currently holds.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no two distinct shedding units are ever assigned to the same feeder slot at the same time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m9p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Lines, Stalls, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, holds
vars == <<epoch, holds>>

Init == epoch = 0 /\ holds = [l \in Lines |-> "none"]

Claim(l, s) == holds[l] = "none" /\ (\A o \in Lines : holds[o] # s)
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![l] = s] /\ UNCHANGED epoch
Release(l) == holds[l] # "none" /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![l] = "none"] /\ UNCHANGED epoch
Reconfigure == epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1 /\ holds' = [l \in Lines |-> "none"]

Next == Reconfigure \/ (\E l \in Lines : Release(l)) \/ (\E l \in Lines, s \in Stalls : Claim(l, s))
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoSharedStall ==
    \A a, b \in Lines : (a # b /\ holds[a] # "none") => holds[a] # holds[b]
====
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line assigns wash stalls to two lines that share a common stall pool, using epoch-numbered reconfiguration. A configuration epoch counts reconfigurations. A line may claim a free stall only if no other line currently holds that stall. A reconfiguration bumps the epoch and clears every current stall assignment, forcing all lines to re-claim under the new configuration. A line may also release its stall voluntarily. The model tracks the current configuration epoch and, for each line, which stall it currently holds.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no two distinct lines are ever assigned to the same wash stall at the same time.
